args.command:
set -euo pipefail
export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug_task"
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux
export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"
export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"
export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"
FIXTURES=(/opt/nothingness/media/*.opus)
# sort by version-like: 01..10
IFS=$'\n' FIXTURES=($(ls -1 /opt/nothingness/media/*.opus | sort -V))
CSV=$(printf "%s," "${FIXTURES[@]}" | sed 's/,$//')
echo "Fixtures CSV: $CSV"

# Queue once
/workspace/.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py call ext.nothingness.setQueue "paths=$CSV" "startIndex=0" >/dev/null
# Ensure playing
/workspace/.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py call ext.nothingness.play >/dev/null

# Enable shuffle via settings toggle
/workspace/.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py screen void >/dev/null
/workspace/.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py settings open >/dev/null
# tap toggle until shuffle=true
for i in {1..3}; do
  /workspace/.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py call ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState | jq -e '.result.shuffle==true' >/dev/null && break
  /workspace/.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py tap void-settings-status-shuffle >/dev/null
  sleep 0.5
done

# Wait for a playing track to be loaded
before=""
for t in {1..100}; do
  st=$(/workspace/.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py call ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState)
  before=$(echo "$st" | jq -r '.result.songInfo.path // empty')
  isPlaying=$(echo "$st" | jq -r '.result.isPlaying')
  if [[ "$isPlaying" == "true" && -n "$before" ]]; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 0.2
done
if [[ -z "$before" ]]; then
  echo "Failed to get playing songInfo.path" >&2
  echo "$st" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Verify beforePath in fixtures
case " ${FIXTURES[*]} " in
  *"$before"*) echo "beforePath=$before" ;;
  *) echo "beforePath not in fixtures: $before" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

# Advance exactly one track transition: next
/workspace/.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py next >/dev/null

after=""
for t in {1..150}; do
  st=$(/workspace/.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py call ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState)
  after=$(echo "$st" | jq -r '.result.songInfo.path // empty')
  if [[ -n "$after" && "$after" != "$before" ]]; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 0.2
done
if [[ -z "$after" || "$after" == "$before" ]]; then
  echo "Failed to observe track transition. before=$before after=$after" >&2
  echo "$st" >&2
  exit 1
fi

case " ${FIXTURES[*]} " in
  *"$after"*) echo "afterPath=$after" ;;
  *) echo "afterPath not in fixtures: $after" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

# Small sanity: ensure no immediate second transition
sleep 0.8
st2=$(/workspace/.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py call ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState)
latest=$(echo "$st2" | jq -r '.result.songInfo.path // empty')
if [[ "$latest" != "$after" ]]; then
  echo "Unexpected additional transition: after=$after latest=$latest" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "OK: shuffled=$(/workspace/.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py call ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState | jq -r '.result.shuffle')"
echo "Transitioned via next exactly once: $before -> $after"
